Your senses pick up only a tiny slice of what is there.

Kevin Trudeau explains that our eyes catch only a small spectrum of light. A bat would say it sees more, a dog smells and hears far more than we do, and a dog whistle makes no sound to us at all.

He says what we actually experience with our physical senses is incredibly small. He also shares that as a child he never thought it unusual to see energy.

What might you be missing because you trust only what you can see?
